author: Shafiqul Islam
title: Very reliable power station during load shedding
comment: Purchased for our Dhaka apartment. It runs our refrigerator and 4 fans silently for hours. High quality build.

author: Testing User
title: Amazing Backup
comment: Runs smoothly and silently during Dhaka load shedding.

author: Engr. Rafiqul Islam
title: Outstanding load-shedding backup for our home!
comment: Installed this Jackery 2000 v2 in our Dhanmondi apartment. It seamlessly powers our refrigerator, 4 fans, multiple lights, and router during long load shedding. The pure sine wave inverter is whisper quiet and the app monitoring is very convenient.

author: Kazi Mahfuzur Rahman
title: Genuine product and fast delivery in Chittagong
comment: MaxiTShop delivered this within 48 hours to Chittagong with Cash on Delivery. Original sealed unit with warranty card. Charges rapidly from wall outlet in just under 2 hours.

author: Tanvir Hasan
title: Best ANC earbuds in this budget
comment: The active noise cancellation blocks Dhaka city traffic noise easily. Bass is punchy without distorting vocals. Battery easily lasts 6+ hours on a single charge with ANC on.

author: Nusrat Jahan
title: Great sound quality and comfortable fit
comment: Very comfortable in the ears even during long office calls. The app EQ settings are handy. Minor delay in gaming mode, but for music and calls it is 10/10.

author: Mohammad Shariful Alam
title: Complete off-grid peace of mind for our factory
comment: The Deye 6KW hybrid inverter combined with Deye 5KWh lithium battery is top tier. The net-metering setup passed DESCO inspection without issues. Generating 24-28 units per sunny day.

author: Samiul Haque
title: 180Hz Fast IPS for CS2 and Valorant
comment: Colours are super vivid with zero ghosting. The 180Hz refresh rate is silky smooth. Came with HDMI and DisplayPort cables included. No dead pixels found.

author: Dr. Ahsan Habib
title: High efficiency panels, solid build quality
comment: Installed 6 units of these 550W Mono PERC panels on our rooftop in Rajshahi. Even during cloudy monsoon days, the voltage stays above 38V. Heavy duty aluminum frame.

author: Farzana Yeasmin
title: Excellent performance and genuine tier-1 cells
comment: The panels are performing better than expected. Customer support was very helpful in coordinating delivery to our home in Sylhet. Recommended seller!
